showCountGlyphOnMergedEdges.description: Whether to show a glyph with the count of constituent edges of a merged edge.

countGlyphSize.description:
The enlargement factor of the glyph with the count of constituent edges of a merged edge.
The {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationMergedEdgeConfig#showCountGlyphOnMergedEdges} property must be set to true
in order for the glyph to be shown.

flow.description: Sets a flow animation on the link.

flowVelocity.description:
Sets the velocity of the flow animation on an edge.
The {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationMergedEdgeConfig#flow} property must be set to true in order for this
to be applied.

title:
Configurations for the {@link UiSdlGraphVisualization#mergedEdgeConfig}.
By default, edges are merged. This can be disabled with {@link UiSdlGraphVisualization#disableMergedEdges}.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationMergedEdgeConfig
